reference: R. W. Boyd, Nonlinear Optics (3rd ed.), Ch. 2 (SHG coupled-wave equations); M. M. Fejer, G. A. Magel, D. H. Jundt & R. L. Byer, IEEE J. Quantum Electron. 28, 2631 (1992) (quasi-phase-matching)
description: Textbook SHG: conversion efficiency eta = tanh^2(kappa L) with kappa = sigma sqrt(P0), plus first-order QPM recovery of a deliberately mismatched interaction.
